subtopicTitle.ta: 1.2 நிலைமம் மற்றும் நியூட்டனின் முதல் இயக்க விதி

stem.en: An inherent property of a physical body to resist any change in its state of rest or uniform motion is defined as:
stem.ta: ஒரு பொருள் தன் ஓய்வு நிலையையோ, அல்லது சீரான இயக்க நிலையையோ மாற்றிக்கொள்ளாமல் இருக்கும் உள்ளார்ந்த பண்பு எவ்வாறு அழைக்கப்படுகிறது?

socraticCues.distractor_1: Linear momentum measures mass × velocity, but what opposes change in state?
socraticCues.distractor_2: Impulse is a very large force acting for a very short duration, not an inherent resistance property.
socraticCues.distractor_3: Torque causes angular rotational acceleration about an axis.

explanation.en: Inertia is the natural tendency of an object to resist changes in its state of motion (Newton's First Law).
explanation.ta: நிலைமம் என்பது ஒரு பொருள் புறவிசை செயல்படாதவரை தனது ஓய்வு நிலையையோ அல்லது இயக்க நிலையையோ மாற்றிக்கொள்ள இயலாத இயல்பான பண்பாகும்.

analogies.sports: Like a football resting motionless on the penalty spot that will never move until kicked by a striker's boot.
analogies.gaming: Like a high-tier Tank hero with maximum Knockback Immunity who cannot be pushed back by ordinary mob attacks.
analogies.cooking: Like a heavy iron skillet that stays anchored on the stove until deliberately lifted by the chef.
analogies.daily_life: Like passengers abruptly lurching forward when a fast-moving city bus slams on the brakes.

bookCitation.subject: Science
bookCitation.excerpt: The inherent property of a body to resist any change in its state of rest or the state of uniform motion, unless it is influenced upon by an external unbalanced force, is known as 'inertia'.

subtopicTitle.en: 1.4 Newton's Second Law of Motion (F = ma)

stem.en: According to Newton's Second Law of Motion, the force acting on a body is mathematically expressed as:
stem.ta: நியூட்டனின் இரண்டாம் இயக்க விதியின்படி, ஒரு பொருளின் மீது செயல்படும் விசைக்கான கணிதச் சமன்பாடு எது?

socraticCues.distractor_0: Remember force is directly proportional to both mass and acceleration, not inversely.
socraticCues.distractor_2: ½mv² is kinetic energy, which measures mechanical work capacity, not force.
socraticCues.distractor_3: m × v is linear momentum (p), while force is the rate of change of momentum (dp/dt).

explanation.en: Force equals the rate of change of linear momentum: F = dp/dt = d(mv)/dt = m × a.
explanation.ta: பொருளொன்றின் மீது செயல்படும் விசையானது அப்பொருளின் உந்த மாறுபாட்டு வீதத்திற்கு நேர்விகிதத்தில் அமையும்: F = m × a.

analogies.sports: Kicking a lightweight tennis ball produces massive speed (high acceleration), but kicking a heavy medicine ball with the same force produces sluggish movement.
analogies.gaming: Applying the same Attack Power stat produces high projectile speed for light arrows, but slower trajectory for heavy siege cannonballs.
analogies.cooking: Pushing a light spatula through milk requires tiny force, while pushing through stiff bread dough requires maximum muscle power.
analogies.daily_life: Pushing an empty supermarket grocery cart vs. pushing a cart loaded with 50 kg of sacks.

bookCitation.subject: Science
bookCitation.excerpt: The force acting on a body is directly proportional to the rate of change of linear momentum of the body and the change in momentum takes place in the direction of the force. Hence, F = m × a.
